paragraphs.zh: 《农药》第56卷第5期报道了玉米田除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，在合成2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的时候，以危险性较大的溴素为溴化剂；在合成2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的时候，使用了甲醇钠为原料，甲醇钠易燃、易爆、对空气与湿气敏感，遇水迅速分解成甲醇和氢氧化钠，工业化过程中使用条件苛刻，在环磺酮的合成的时候使用了乙腈，乙腈属于管制类中等毒性化学品，因极易挥发，再生产过程中容易造成慢性中毒事故。
paragraphs.en: Volume 56, issue 5 of 《Nongyao》 (Pesticides) reported a synthesis process for the maize-field herbicide tembotrione. In synthesising methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, elemental bromine, which is comparatively hazardous, was used as the brominating agent; in synthesising 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, sodium methoxide was used as a raw material, and sodium methoxide is flammable, explosive and sensitive to air and moisture, decomposing rapidly on contact with water into methanol and sodium hydroxide, so the conditions for its use in an industrial process are demanding; in the synthesis of tembotrione acetonitrile was used, and acetonitrile belongs to the controlled, moderately toxic chemicals, and because it is extremely volatile it again in the production process readily causes chronic poisoning accidents.
paragraphs.notes: PROVENANCE (applies to every zh field on this page): the Chinese was EXTRACTED FROM THE PDF's OWN EMBEDDED TEXT LAYER, not read off pixels. CN109678767A is born digital and all 11 pages carry a real text layer, so every character in every zh field on this page is the publication's own encoded text, transcribed byte for byte. The image was used only to confirm layout (header, footer, paragraph order, absence of drawings) and to spot-check chemically load-bearing runs. LINE JOINING: the text layer stores each printed line separately; lines belonging to one paragraph have been concatenated with NO inserted whitespace, because CJK line wrapping introduces no space. Nothing else was altered. PUNCTUATION, verified by codepoint over the whole page: prose commas are FULL-WIDTH ， (U+FF0C), enumeration marks are 、 (U+3001), periods 。, semicolons ；, colons in prose ：; commas inside Latin-script locant strings ('2,2,2-', '1,3-', '1 ,2-') are HALF-WIDTH ',' (U+002C); every hyphen on the page is ASCII '-' (U+002D); every parenthesis is ASCII '(' ')'; ranges use the FULL-WIDTH TILDE ～ (U+FF5E); the degree sign is ℃ (U+2103). Unlike the CN104292137A scan, punctuation width here IS reliable and downstream passes may depend on it. CHEMISTRY FLAGS, transcribed as printed and not corrected: (1) '再生产过程中' reads 再 ('again'), verified in the image at high magnification, where context requires the homophone 在 ('during'); the English keeps the printed reading. (2) The prior-art reagent for the etherification is named 甲醇钠 (SODIUM METHOXIDE), not 三氟乙醇钠 (sodium trifluoroethoxide); sodium methoxide is the base that would generate the trifluoroethoxide in situ, so naming it as the raw material is chemically coherent and has NOT been reinterpreted. This paragraph is PRIOR ART criticism (报道了, 'reported'), describing the journal route, not the invention's route.

Printed in bold on its own line between [0009] and [0010], with no paragraph marker and no indent. It is a section heading, not body text, and marks the transition from the background/prior-art discussion to the invention proper. Literally 'content of the invention'. Recorded as its own entry rather than folded into an adjacent paragraph so that its unmarked status is preserved. Ends with a full-width colon ： as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明的目的就是针对上述方法存在的不足之处，提供一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，从生产安全角度出发，通过改进其工艺路线，使用低危险性化学品代替高危险性化学品，使用低毒化学品代替高毒化学品，简化了工艺过程，提高了收率，降低合成成本，减少了三废排放，适合工业化放大生产。
paragraphs.en: The object of the present invention is, directed at the deficiencies of the above method, to provide a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione which, proceeding from the standpoint of production safety, improves its process route, uses low-hazard chemicals in place of high-hazard chemicals and low-toxicity chemicals in place of highly toxic chemicals, simplifies the process, raises the yield, lowers the synthesis cost, reduces the discharge of the three wastes, and is suitable for scaled-up industrial production.
paragraphs.notes: 三废 ('three wastes') is the standard Chinese industrial term for waste gas, waste water and waste residue; rendered literally as 'the three wastes' rather than expanded, because the paragraph does not enumerate them. This paragraph states the invention's aims qualitatively only: no yield figure, no cost figure and no comparative number of any kind appears here.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明通过如下技术方案实现：
paragraphs.en: The present invention is realised by the following technical scheme:

paragraphs.zh: 一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，包括有以下步骤：
paragraphs.en: A synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising the following steps:
paragraphs.notes: 环磺酮 is the Chinese common name for tembotrione. Note this patent writes 环磺酮 throughout, whereas CN104292137A writes 环磺草酮 for the same target; recorded so a downstream pass does not read the two spellings as two different compounds. No structure is drawn anywhere on this page, so the identification rests on the name alone.

paragraphs.zh: 1)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成
paragraphs.notes: Step number uses a half-width ')' with no opening bracket, as printed. There is no space between '1)' and '2-氯' in the text layer.

paragraphs.zh: 将2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、溶剂、催化剂、氢溴酸加入反应瓶，在80℃以下滴加双氧水，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗，浓缩，加溶剂进行重结晶，过滤得2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯；
paragraphs.en: Methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, solvent, catalyst and hydrobromic acid are charged into a reaction flask; hydrogen peroxide is added dropwise at below 80℃; after the addition is complete the reaction is continued and followed by LC until the reaction is complete; after completion the layers are separated, the organic layer is washed with water and concentrated, solvent is added for recrystallisation, and filtration gives methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;
paragraphs.notes: 双氧水 is aqueous hydrogen peroxide (H2O2 solution); concentration is not stated. 氢溴酸 is hydrobromic acid (aqueous HBr). LC = liquid chromatography, used as the in-process control. This is the invention's replacement for the prior-art elemental-bromine bromination criticised in [0009]: HBr plus H2O2 generates the brominating species in situ. The identities of 'solvent' and 'catalyst' are deferred to [0020] and [0021]. No reaction time, no charge quantity and no yield are given.

paragraphs.zh: 2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
paragraphs.notes: Parentheses around '2,2,2-三氟乙氧基' are SYMMETRIC half-width ASCII '(' and ')' here and everywhere else on this page, unlike the asymmetric narrow-open / wide-close pair seen in CN104292137A. Verified by codepoint. The step-2 product is named as the free ACID, consistent with the alkaline hydrolysis at the end of [0016].

paragraphs.zh: 将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、碱1、催化剂、溶剂、2,2,2-三氟乙醇加入反应瓶，在80℃以下进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，有机层水洗，浓缩；往剩余物里加碱2、水，在80℃以下进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸；
paragraphs.en: Methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, base 1, catalyst, solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol are charged into a reaction flask and reacted at below 80℃, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; after the reaction is finished the mixture is filtered, the organic layer is washed with water and concentrated; base 2 and water are added to the residue and alkaline hydrolysis is carried out at below 80℃, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; after completion hydrochloric acid is added dropwise to acidify, and the product is filtered, washed and dried to give 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid;
paragraphs.notes: Two operations in one paragraph: (a) Williamson-type etherification of the benzylic bromide with FREE 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol plus 'base 1' and a catalyst - this is the invention's replacement for the prior-art sodium methoxide route criticised in [0009], since the alkoxide is never isolated; (b) 碱解, alkaline hydrolysis (saponification) of the methyl ester with 'base 2', then acidification to the free acid. The methyl ester intermediate formed between (a) and (b) is never named in this paragraph. 碱 1 and 碱 2 are literally 'base 1' and 'base 2', defined in [0023]; the catalyst is likewise defined in [0023]. The SOLVENT for step 2) is NOT defined anywhere on this page ([0021] defines solvents for step 1) only); it presumably appears on a later page. No charge quantities, no reaction times and no yield.

paragraphs.zh: 将2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、催化剂、氯化亚砜、溶剂加入反应瓶，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂；将1,3-环己二酮、溶剂加入反应瓶，在30℃以下滴加三乙胺，LC跟踪至反应完全；反应完全后，加入丙酮氰醇，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加溶剂进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得米黄色固体环磺酮。
paragraphs.en: 2-Chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, catalyst, thionyl chloride and solvent are charged into a reaction flask, the temperature is raised and the mixture is reacted at reflux, and after the reaction is finished the solvent is stripped off completely; 1,3-cyclohexanedione and solvent are charged into a reaction flask, triethylamine is added dropwise at below 30℃, and the reaction is followed by LC until it is complete; after the reaction is complete, acetone cyanohydrin is added and the reaction is followed by LC until it is complete; after completion water is added for a water wash, the layers are separated, the solvent is stripped completely from the oil layer, solvent is added for recrystallisation, and filtration and drying give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid.
paragraphs.notes: 氯化亚砜 = thionyl chloride (SOCl2), for acid chloride formation. 丙酮氰醇 = ACETONE CYANOHYDRIN, verified in the image at high magnification character by character; note this is NOT 氰基丙酮 (cyanoacetone), which is what the comparable paragraph of CN104292137A prints. 三乙胺 = triethylamine. 环己二酮 is given here WITH its locant, '1,3-环己二酮' (1,3-cyclohexanedione), unlike CN104292137A which omits it. 米黄色 rendered literally as 'rice-yellow', i.e. beige/cream. STRUCTURAL GAP IN THE PROSE: the paragraph describes two separate flasks and never states that the acid chloride from the first is transferred into the second; the coupling is implied by the fact that a single product results, but the transfer operation is not written. Transcribed as printed and flagged in discrepancies. The 'catalyst' of the SOCl2 step and the two 'solvents' are not defined anywhere on this page. No charge quantities, no reaction times, no yield and no melting point.

paragraphs.zh: 优选的，步骤1)中，2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、催化剂、氢溴酸、双氧水的摩尔比为1:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step 1) the molar ratio of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, catalyst, hydrobromic acid and hydrogen peroxide is 1:0.01-0.1:1-2:1-2.
paragraphs.notes: Four components named, four ratio positions given; the count matches. Verified in the image: '1:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2'. The range mark as printed is the FULL-WIDTH TILDE ～ (U+FF5E), rendered as a plain hyphen in the English only. Colons are half-width ASCII. Note the catalyst loading is sub-stoichiometric (0.01-0.1 equivalents), consistent with a radical initiator rather than a true catalyst.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步的，步骤1)中，所述催化剂为偶氮二异丁腈或间氯过氧苯甲酸；双氧水的滴加温度为45～80℃。
paragraphs.en: Further, in step 1) said catalyst is azobisisobutyronitrile or m-chloroperoxybenzoic acid; the dropwise addition temperature of the hydrogen peroxide is 45-80℃.
paragraphs.notes: 偶氮二异丁腈 = azobisisobutyronitrile (AIBN). 间氯过氧苯甲酸 = m-chloroperoxybenzoic acid (mCPBA), verified in the image character by character; it is NOT 过氧苯甲酸 (perbenzoic acid) and NOT 过氧化苯甲酰 (benzoyl peroxide). Both species are called 催化剂 ('catalyst') by the patent although both function as radical initiators/oxidants; the patent's own word is kept. mCPBA in this role is unusual and is flagged in discrepancies rather than reinterpreted. The 45-80℃ addition window is narrower than the 'below 80℃' of [0014] and adds a lower bound that [0014] does not state.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步的，步骤1)中，所述反应溶剂为二氯甲烷、1 ,2-二氯乙烷或氯仿；所述结晶溶剂为甲醇、乙醇、异丙醇或正丁醇。
paragraphs.en: Further, in step 1) said reaction solvent is dichloromethane, 1,2-dichloroethane or chloroform; said crystallisation solvent is methanol, ethanol, isopropanol or n-butanol.
paragraphs.notes: TRANSCRIPTION DETAIL: the text layer stores '1 ,2-二氯乙烷' with a LITERAL SPACE between the '1' and the ',', and that space has been reproduced verbatim in the zh field per the no-normalisation rule. The image confirms the cause: CNIPA justification puts visible air on both sides of the comma in Latin-script locant runs ('1 , 2-'), and the PDF encoded one of those gaps as a real space character. It is a typesetting artifact carrying no chemical meaning; the compound is 1,2-dichloroethane and the English drops the space. Downstream passes matching on locant strings must tolerate it. This is the only such embedded space on the page. Solvent lists are separated by the enumeration mark 、 throughout. [0021] defines solvents for step 1) ONLY.

paragraphs.zh: 优选的，步骤2)中，2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、碱1、催化剂、2,2,2-三氟乙醇、碱2的摩尔比为1:1～2:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step 2) the molar ratio of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, base 1, catalyst, 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol and base 2 is 1:1-2:0.01-0.1:1-2:1-2.
paragraphs.notes: Five components named, five ratio positions given; the count matches. Verified in the image: '1:1～2:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2'. The catalyst is again sub-stoichiometric at 0.01-0.1 equivalents, consistent with the phase-transfer / nucleophilic-catalysis role of the amine named in [0023]. Note the component ORDER here (substrate, base 1, catalyst, trifluoroethanol, base 2) differs from the charging order in [0016] (substrate, base 1, catalyst, solvent, trifluoroethanol); solvent is absent from the ratio list, as expected.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步的，步骤2)中，所述碱1为碳酸钾；所述催化剂为三乙烯二胺或2-甲基三乙烯二胺；所述碱2为氢氧化钠、氢氧化钾或氢氧化锂。
paragraphs.en: Further, in step 2) said base 1 is potassium carbonate; said catalyst is triethylenediamine or 2-methyltriethylenediamine; said base 2 is sodium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide or lithium hydroxide.
paragraphs.notes: 碳酸钾 = potassium carbonate. 三乙烯二胺 = triethylenediamine, the Chinese common name for DABCO (1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane); 乙烯 here is part of that fixed common name and does NOT mean the compound contains vinyl groups, so it has been translated as the common name rather than parsed literally. 2-甲基三乙烯二胺 = 2-methyltriethylenediamine (2-methyl-DABCO). 碱 2 is the saponification base for the ester hydrolysis half of [0016]. This is the last paragraph on the page; [0024] onward continues on the following page.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text (there are NO drawings on this page). Step 3) describes two separate reaction flasks but never states that the contents of the first are combined with the contents of the second, so the actual coupling operation is missing from the written procedure.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page; both statements below are prose
discrepancies.text_says: [0018] reads '…加入反应瓶，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂；将1,3-环己二酮、溶剂加入反应瓶，在 30℃以下滴加三乙胺…'. The acid chloride is formed and the solvent stripped in flask one; 1,3-cyclohexanedione, solvent and triethylamine are charged to flask two; no sentence joins them. The transfer is inferable from the fact that a single product is obtained, but it is NOT written, and it has not been inferred into the transcription or the translation.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. The radical initiator for the step-1 benzylic bromination is called a 'catalyst' and one of the two options given is m-chloroperoxybenzoic acid, an oxidant not normally used as a radical initiator.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0020] reads '所述催化剂为偶氮二异丁腈或间氯过氧苯甲酸' = 'said catalyst is azobisisobutyronitrile or m-chloroperoxybenzoic acid'. Verified in the image character by character: the second reagent carries the 间 (meta) prefix and reads mCPBA, distinct both from the 过氧苯甲酸 (perbenzoic acid) printed in CN104292137A and from 过氧化苯甲酰 (benzoyl peroxide). [0019] loads it at 0.01-0.1 equivalents, i.e. as an initiator. Recorded as printed; a downstream chemistry pass should treat the initiator identity as flagged rather than settled.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. Reagent slots used in the procedure paragraphs are left undefined on this page: the step-2 solvent, and both the catalyst and the two solvents of step 3).
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0016] charges a '溶剂' and [0018] charges a '催化剂' plus two '溶剂', but the definition paragraphs on this page stop at [0023], which covers only step 2)'s bases and catalyst. [0021] defines solvents for step 1) alone. This is almost certainly continuation on the following page rather than an omission, but it is recorded so a pass reading p04 in isolation does not treat the route as fully specified.

discrepancies.what: Printing / text-layer artifact that downstream passes must not read as meaningful. One locant string carries an embedded space.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0021] is encoded as '二氯甲烷、1 ,2-二氯乙烷或氯仿' with a literal U+0020 between '1' and ','. The image shows CNIPA justification air on both sides of that comma ('1 , 2-'). Reproduced verbatim in zh per the no-normalisation rule; the compound is 1,2-dichloroethane. It is the only embedded space inside a locant string on this page, and every other locant run ('2,2,2-', '1,3-') is unspaced.

discrepancies.what: Text-layer-vs-image. The footer page number appears twice in the extracted text layer but only once on the rendered page.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page
discrepancies.text_says: The text layer emits, after the body, the sequence '说　明　书' / '2/9 页' / '4' / 'CN 109678767 A' / '4'. The image shows exactly one '4', centred at the foot of the page, and the header band 'CN 109678767 A' left, '说 明 书' centred, '2/9 页' right. The second '4' has no visible counterpart on the page and is treated as a duplicated PDF text object, not as page content. The image was taken as authoritative for layout here, per the layout-vs-characters rule.

discrepancies.what: Text-vs-text. A character in the prior-art criticism is printed as 再 ('again') where the sentence requires its homophone 在 ('during').
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page
discrepancies.text_says: [0009] reads '因极易挥发，再生产过程中容易造成慢性中毒事故。' Verified in the image at high magnification as 再, not 在. Almost certainly a typing error for '在生产过程中' ('in the production process'). Transcribed and translated as printed per the no-typo-fixing rule; it carries no chemical content.
